headline: Cocktail bomb explodes on Barishal court premises
summary: The blast occurred around 10:45 AM on Wednesday, briefly disrupting court proceedings and prompting an immediate security response.
details: A cocktail bomb exploded on the premises of the Barishal District and Sessions Judge Court on Wednesday morning.
Court police reported that the blast took place at approximately 10:45 AM, causing a sudden loud noise that alarmed witnesses and those present at the court.
Police officers on duty at the court arrived at the scene immediately after the explosion, but they were unable to identify the perpetrators involved in the incident.
Following the event, senior officials from the administration, Police, and the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) visited the site to inspect the area and investigate the investigation.
The explosion briefly disrupted court proceedings as security forces worked to secure the perimeter and gather evidence from the blast site.
caption:
A cocktail bomb blast at the Barishal District Court on Wednesday morning caused panic and the sudden disruption of court proceedings.

A cocktail bomb exploded on the premises of the Barishal District and Sessions Judge Court on Wednesday morning.

Court police reported that the blast took place at approximately 10:45 AM, causing a sudden loud noise that alarmed witnesses and those present at the court.

Police officers on duty at the court arrived at the scene immediately after the explosion, but they were unable to identify the perpetrators involved in the incident.

Following the event, senior officials from the administration, Police, and the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) visited the site to inspect the area and investigate the investigation.

The explosion briefly disrupted court proceedings as security forces worked to secure the perimeter and gather evidence from the blast site.

headline_marked: Savar: [[Pressure cooker wrapped in black tape]] sparks bomb scare
headline: Savar: Pressure cooker wrapped in black tape sparks bomb scare
summary: Police cordoned off a field in Sadhapur after residents found a suspicious object in a blue plastic drum.
details: Police cordoned off an open field beside a mosque in Savar’s Sadhapur this morning after a pressure cooker wrapped in black tape was found, raising suspicions of a bomb.
The object was discovered by local residents late Tuesday night inside a blue plastic drum at the field of Laltek Ghora Mosque in the Goper Bari area of Sadhapur.
Residents reported that three unidentified people had left the plastic drum at the mosque field during the night and fled the scene.
The pressure cooker was found along with clothes and a copy of the Quran inside the drum.
Bhabanipur Police Outpost in-charge SI Imran Hossain stated that the bomb disposal unit has been informed and is on their way to examine the object.

This incident occurs just hours after the Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime unit and the Bomb Disposal Unit recovered several crude bomb-like objects and nine pipe bombs from a rented flat in Savar’s Shyampur.
The Shyampur operation was triggered by information provided by a man arrested in Hemayetpur.
